name: Akira !
source:
This is a game about a weird man named Akira... and you I guess. Your boyfriend chased you out of your apartment after thwacking you, and you pass out due to your fear of blood while trying to explain to Akira what you need.

[From [url=https://shylynin.itch.io/akira-akira]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一款关于名叫Akira的怪人的游戏……大概也关于你。男友打了你，还把你赶出公寓。你正试图向Akira说明自己需要什么，却因为晕血而昏倒了。

[摘自[url=https://shylynin.itch.io/akira-akira]itch.io[/url]]
